ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a large, irregular black pigmentation blob. Lateral margins and distal tips exhibit high-density white mottling and fine-line reticulated patterns that extend into the central dark area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 12% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge topography characterized by a series of low-amplitude serrations and a notable larger indentation/notch on the superior margin of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the upper lateral margins of both lobes, transitioning to a concave sweep as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters situated along the lower-left margin and near the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally across the central black pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface; significant irregular traumatic notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, fine-lined reticulated 'web-like' white pigmentation pattern overlaying the primary black regions of the fluke mid-section.
